==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*steh₂-}}
A {{lbor|en|la|status|nocap=1}}. A {{dbt|en|state|estate|nocap=1}}. Displaced native {{noncog|ang|hād||rank, status}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsteɪ.təs/|ref1=[https://merriam-webster.com/dictionary/status]|a=RP,IE,South Africa}}
* {{audio|en|en-gb-status.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsteɪt.əs/|[ˈsteɪɾ.əs]|a=GA,CA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈstæt.əs/|[ˈstæɾ.əs]|a=US,CA,AU,IE}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-status.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈstæɪ.təs/|[ˈstæɪɾ.əs]|a=AU,NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈstɛː.təs/|/ˈsteː.təs/|a=Northern England,Northern Ireland,Scotland,Wales,many accents}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪtəs|ætəs|s1=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~|+|status|stati<l:hypercorrect>}}

# A person’s [[condition]], [[position]] or [[standing]] relative to that of others.
#: {{syn|en|place}}
#: {{ux|en|Superstition is highly correlated with economic '''status'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Time|title=When Did On-Screen Weddings Get So Bleak?|date=May 27 2026|author=Judy Berman
|text=This time, there’s no great discrepancy in '''status'''; both fiancés are part of the urban, white-collar middle class.
|url=https://time.com/article/2026/05/14/testaments-finale-red-wedding-season/
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260528000830/https://time.com/article/2026/05/14/testaments-finale-red-wedding-season/}}
# {{cap|prestige}} or high standing.
# A [[situation]] or [[state of affairs]].
#: {{nearsyn|en|footing}}
#: {{ux|en|What's the '''status''' of the investigation?}}
#: {{ux|en|New York is known for its '''status''' as a financial center.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2014-03-15|volume=410|issue=8878
|title=[http://www.economist.com/news/leaders/21598997-american-regulators-should-block-comcasts-proposed-deal-time-warner-cable-turn-it Turn It Off]
|passage=If the takeover is approved, Comcast would control 20 of the top 25 cable markets, […]. Antitrust officials will need to consider Comcast's '''status''' as a monopsony (a buyer with disproportionate power), when it comes to negotiations with programmers, whose channels it pays to carry.}}
# {{lb|en|legal}} The [[legal]] [[condition]] of a person or thing.
## {{lb|en|Canada|usually|used to modify another noun}} The state (of a Canadian [[First Nations]] person) of being registered under the [[w:Indian Act|Indian Act]].
##: {{ux|en|He is a '''status''' Indian.}}
# {{lb|en|social media}} A function of some instant messaging applications, whereby a user may post a message that appears automatically to other users, if they attempt to make contact.
#: {{ux|en|I'm just about to update my '''status''' to "busy".}}
#* {{quote-song|en|year=2012|title=Facebook Drama|album=|url=|artist=w:Northern Cree
|passage=I read your '''status''' last night / You posted that someone else was holding you tight}}
# {{lb|en|medicine}} {{n-g|Short for {{m|en|status epilepticus}} or {{m|en|status asthmaticus}}.}}

====Usage notes====
* Rarely, {{m|en|statūs}} (following Latin) is found as the plural form.
